description.zh-CN: 用温和的生活盘点、优先级梳理和小步行动，帮助你把重要的事安排进现实生活。
description.en-US: Turn a gentle life assessment into clear priorities, small actions, and a realistic review rhythm.

capabilities.zh-CN: 盘点由你选择的生活领域
capabilities.en-US: Assess only the life areas you choose

capabilities.zh-CN: 找出一至三个当前优先事项
capabilities.en-US: Identify one to three current priorities

capabilities.zh-CN: 形成可执行的本周行动与复盘
capabilities.en-US: Create practical weekly actions and reviews

examples.zh-CN: 帮我盘点最近的生活状态，先从工作、家庭和休息开始。
examples.en-US: Help me assess work, family, and rest first.

examples.zh-CN: 我有很多想改善的事，帮我只选三个优先项。
examples.en-US: I want to improve many things; help me choose only three priorities.

examples.zh-CN: 根据这份近况记录，做一份不压迫的本周行动计划。
examples.en-US: Turn these notes into a low-pressure action plan for this week.

boundary.zh-CN: 仅处理用户主动提供的生活信息；不主动监控，不替代医疗、法律、财务或心理专业意见。
boundary.en-US: Uses only information the user explicitly provides; no active monitoring and no substitute for medical, legal, financial, or mental-health professionals.

sources.modifications: Translated and condensed the reflective assessment, optional scoring, priority selection, and action-plan workflow; removed persistence and assumed ten-area coverage.
sources.securityReviewNotes: Reviewed as a prose workflow. Storage automation and integration assumptions were excluded.

sources.modifications: Retained user-controlled prioritization, quick wins, energy awareness, and feedback; removed passive data collection, prediction, notifications, and recommendation engines.
sources.securityReviewNotes: No executable was included. Active monitoring, behavioral inference, and automatic actions were removed.
